text.en:
Section 12 of Republic Act No. 4864, otherwise known as the "Police Act of 1966" is hereby
amended as follows:
"Sec. 12 Promotion shall be made by the local chief executive concerned upon consultation with, or advice of,
the chief of the local police agency, from among those who shall have passed the corresponding promotional
examination given by the National Police Commission: Provided, That policemen who have been in the
continuous police service for at least twenty years at the time of the effectivity of this Act on September 8,
1966, and who were subsequently promoted, and/or may hereafter be promoted, to higher ranks despite the
lack of educational qualifications prescribed under Section 9(4) hereof shall be considered as possessing such
educational qualifications: Provided, further, That policemen with less than twenty years of continuous service
as herein provided who were likewise promoted to higher ranks despite the lack of said educational
qualification shall retain such rank until the end of school year 1975-76 during which period they are hereby
required to satisfy the prescribed educational requirement: Provided, finally, That those policemen who have
satisfactorily completed any special training course or any combination thereof conducted by the National
Police Commission or other police agencies, upon proper certification by the Chairman of the National Police
Commission, shall likewise be considered as possessing such educational qualifications; otherwise, they revert
to their corresponding lower ranks they held prior to September 8, 1966.

All laws, rules and regulations which are inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed, modified
and/or amended accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.

Done in the City of Manila, this 2nd day of August, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three.
